1.
Heard Shri N.K. Mishra, learned counsel for the petitioners, Ms. Seema Singh, learned counsel for respondents no. 1 to 4 and Shri Rajiv Gupta, learned Addl.

Chief Standing Counsel appearing for respondents no. 5 & 6.
2.
The grievances urged in the instant petition are two fold.

Firstly that the respondents have not paid compensation for pucca well existing over Gata No. 6027 while making award under the provisions of the Railways Act, 1989 and second, that the respondents have taken possession of Ram Kishor And 2 Others vs Union Of India And 5 Others on 9 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97680096/

sentences.text: 1 certain area in excess of the area notified for acquisition.
3. Learned counsel for respondents No. 1 to 4 points out that an award has already been made in respect of the acquired land on 24 April 2023.

In case, the petitioners are aggrieved by the award, it is open to them to seek enhancement of compensation by getting the dispute referred to the Arbitrator as provided under Section 20-F(6) of the Railways Act, 1989.

4. In respect of second grievance, we are of the opinion that respondent no. 5 should get the site inspected by a Revenue Team to find out whether the remaining area of the petitioner's land is still available on the spot or not.
Thereafter, the matter should be placed before the Committee constituted under Government Order dated 12.05.2016 for ascertaining whether possession of any excess land has been taken.
If it comes to the conclusion that possession of any excess land has been taken over by the Railways, the compensation payable shall be determined and paid.

5. Accordingly, the petitioners are permitted to approach respondent no. 6 with a fresh representation along with true attested copy of the instant order in regard to their claim relating to compensation for the excess land allegedly taken over by the respondents.

The said representation as directed above will be decided in accordance with law after getting the site inspected and demarcated by a Survey Team.
6.
The petition stands disposed of accordingly.
